subtitle: Screens at rest. Local agents at work.
corner.label: Trigger corner
restore.label: Restore behavior
language.label: Language
purpose: Take a short break while local agents work. SceneHush darkens supported displays and leaves their apps and your desktop session in place. It does not pause apps, prevent sleep, or guarantee continued tasks.
risk: Dimming is not locking. Anyone nearby can restore the display and use your unlocked Mac. Use macOS Lock Screen in shared spaces or when your Mac must be left securely unattended.
risk.short: Dimming doesn't lock your Mac. Use Lock Screen when it must be left securely unattended.
system.conflict: This corner already has a macOS action
system.explanation: Replace this macOS Hot Corner action with SceneHush? The original setting will be saved so you can restore it in Settings.
system.restoreExplanation: Restore the macOS corner actions saved by SceneHush? SceneHush will be disabled to avoid conflicting actions.
error.config: Could not read or save settings. Check local file permissions.
error.dim: Could not darken the displays; saved state was restored where possible. Check connections. Some displays or drivers may not support native control.
error.restore: Some displays have not been restored. Reconnect them and choose Restore displays now.
error.generic: The change could not be completed. Check the details below and try again.
error.legacy: Recovery data from an older version was found. Restore the displays with that version before using this one.
footer.github.support: Star on GitHub to support the author
onboarding.busy: The displays are still changing. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.welcome.title: Take a little breather.
onboarding.welcome.body: Take a short break while local agents work. Darken supported screens together and return to the same desktop session.
onboarding.permissions.title: No extra permissions.
onboarding.permissions.body: No Accessibility, Screen Recording, or administrator access is needed for dimming and corner detection. SceneHush never reads your screen.
onboarding.demo.explanation: Your supported displays will turn black, then gently return to normal over 5 seconds. Press Esc to restore immediately, or skip.
onboarding.demo.title: Don't worry. It's just the screens.
onboarding.demo.body: SceneHush only changes display output. Your local agents' apps and desktop session stay in place as the screens brighten. No apps are paused.
onboarding.complete.title: Welcome back.
onboarding.complete.body: Pick a corner for your next short break while local agents work. Your apps stay in the same desktop session.
onboarding.complete.restored: Your original display state is restored
onboarding.complete.note: Dimming doesn't lock your Mac or prevent sleep or automatic locking. Whether an agent keeps running depends on its own setup and your system.
onboarding.failed.title: The demo couldn't finish.
onboarding.failed.body: Restoring your saved display state was attempted. Some displays or drivers may not support native dimming. You can try again or continue to settings.
